tools.title: TOOLS
tools.intro: Focused AI utilities that turn messy context into something a person can review, verify, and use. Every live tool exposes evidence and limitations.
tools.principle: AI proposes. Evidence stays visible. A human makes the final decision.

testforge.description: Drafts coverage-focused unit tests, edge cases, and dependency-mocking notes from source code.

sourceCode.label: SOURCE CODE
sourceCode.placeholder: Paste the function or class you want to test...

repolens.description: Turns repository context into an architecture map, dependency risks, and an actionable change plan.

goal.label: ANALYSIS GOAL
goal.placeholder: Example: Add payment retries without breaking order processing
goal.defaultValue: Identify the safest path to add audit logging.

repositoryContext.label: REPOSITORY CONTEXT
repositoryContext.placeholder: Paste a README, file tree, architecture notes, or selected source files...

incidentlens.description: Organizes logs and stack traces into likely causes, evidence, verification steps, and a recovery checklist.

recentChange.label: RECENT CHANGE
recentChange.defaultValue: Deployed a new database connection pool configuration.

logs.label: LOGS / STACK TRACE
logs.placeholder: Remove secrets, then paste logs or a stack trace...

agentflow.description: Designs a reviewable multi-agent workflow with explicit roles, dependencies, handoffs, and quality gates.

objective.label: PROJECT OBJECTIVE
objective.placeholder: Describe what the agent team should deliver...
objective.defaultValue: Build and release a customer-support assistant that answers from approved product documentation, cites sources, and safely escalates uncertain requests.

techStack.label: TECH STACK
techStack.placeholder: Example: React, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Gemini, Docker

constraints.label: CONSTRAINTS / DEFINITION OF DONE
constraints.placeholder: Security, time, quality, deployment, or review constraints...
constraints.defaultValue: No unverified answers; PII must not be stored; every response needs a source; include automated tests, human review, rollback, and production monitoring.

sqldoctor.description: Reviews schema and query plans to suggest indexes, safer rewrites, and measurements to validate improvements.

scamsignal.description: Structures transaction evidence and suspicious signals into a timeline for human verification.

healthreport.description: Explains report terminology and prepares questions for a clinician without diagnosing or replacing medical advice.
